method: Read-only loader/launcher review plus exact Git-reconstructed NUL-terminated prelude byte search in each frozen binary. No browser test or benchmark rerun.

loader_review.page: CMake generates prelude.inc; src/js/js.cc compiles the static kPrelude array. The only prelude bytecode cache is process-local and generated from that same array.
loader_review.worker: src/js/worker.cc compiles static kWorkerPrelude containing generated shared includes.
loader_review.lazy: src/js/jsnative.cc serves editing and Temporal from static generated arrays.
loader_review.post_bootstrap_hook: src/app/main.c calls js_new before evaluating LUMEN_PRE_FILE as lumen:pre. This does not replace the embedded engine. No runtime filesystem engine-prelude override exists in this reviewed path.

launch_review.performance: agent/validation/performance/compare.py explicitly removes LUMEN_PRE_FILE, LUMEN_WPT_CTRL, LUMEN_TESTDRIVER and LUMEN_TESTDRIVER_URL before launch.
launch_review.focused_wpt: paired_wpt.py and paired_wpt_lf.py write a short private reporter script and explicitly set LUMEN_PRE_FILE to it.
launch_review.broad_wpt: tests/wpt/lumen_wpt.py writes PRE_JS per instance: result reporting, navigation to the controller and a watchdog. The launcher explicitly replaces any inherited LUMEN_PRE_FILE. It does not load engine JavaScript from src/.
launch_review.final_coordinator: agent/validation/linux-wpt-20261028-session3/broad161-final/run_sequence.py clears controller/pre overrides and verifies exact binary and protocol hashes.
